cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You're my deputy. You'll answer the inspector's complaints. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Most of them concern decisions you made.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. You handle the details below decision-making level.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The inspector wants whoever signs the replies at tomorrow's hearing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign as deputy, then. You can represent me without giving the impression we're equals.
